decisive_items: high-sensitivity troponin T of 275 ng/L (<14) peaking at 632 ng/L on hospital day 2
extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement in a mid-wall to epicardial distribution
These findings were consistent with an extensive inflammatory myocardial process
response.rationale: Elevated troponin, inflammatory markers, and CMR findings of mid-wall/epicardial LGE with T2 edema are diagnostic of myocarditis, matching the explicit CMR conclusion.
